title: Tractable Importance Sampling for Monte Carlo Privacy Accounting
abstract: arXiv:2611.17596v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Evaluating tight Differential Privacy (DP) parameters for DP matrix factorization with privacy amplification by sampling requires analyzing high-dimensional, correlated Gaussian mixtures. Because integrating these mixture distributions to find the exact privacy failure probability ($\delta$) is analytically intractable, these mechanisms are typically analyzed using Monte Carlo accounting. However, standard sampling suffers from prohibitive variance when estimating small $\delta$ associated with strict privacy guarantees, which in turn requires a large sample complexity, making Monte Carlo accounting inefficient. We demonstrate that Monte Carlo accounting can be made much more efficient via importance sampling. We give a shifted importance sampling proposal distribution parameterized by a stretch factor $\alpha > 1$. We prove a closed-form bound $B(\alpha) < 1$ on the support of the importance-weighted estimator that holds identically f

translated_title: 蒙特卡洛隐私核算的可处理重要性采样方法
translated_abstract: 对于采用采样隐私放大机制的差分隐私（DP）矩阵分解，评估其紧致的差分隐私参数需要分析高维且相关的（correlated）高斯混合分布。由于对这些混合分布进行积分以求得精确的隐私失败概率（δ）在解析上是不可处理的，这类机制通常通过蒙特卡洛核算来进行分析。然而，在估计与严格隐私保证相关联的极小 δ 值时，标准采样会遭遇难以承受的高方差，进而需要极大的样本复杂度，使得蒙特卡洛核算效率低下。我们证明，通过重要性采样可以大幅提升蒙特卡洛核算的效率。我们提出了一种由拉伸因子 α > 1 参数化的平移重要性采样提议分布，并在重要性加权估计量的支撑集上证明了一个恒成立的闭式界 B(α) < 1……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于平移重要性采样的高效蒙特卡洛隐私核算方法，利用拉伸因子 α 参数化的提议分布及闭式界 B(α) < 1，大幅降低了估计严格隐私保证下极小 δ 值时的方差与样本复杂度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a tractable importance sampling approach for Monte Carlo privacy accounting, using a shifted proposal distribution parameterized by a stretch factor α with a closed-form bound B(α) < 1, drastically reducing variance and sample complexity when estimating small δ under strict privacy guarantees.
